purpose.domain_detail: Argentine student exercise dealing with consortium (consorcios) management - processing multiple sorted input files to produce a listing of deregistered consortiums with their accounts
purpose.summary: This program merges three sorted consortium input files (CONSOR-1, CONSOR-2, CONSOR-3) with an accounts file (CUENTAS) using a multi-way merge algorithm. It identifies consortiums with status=2 (baja/deregistered), counts them, and prints a paginated report. It also loads a status lookup table from a ESTADO file.

notable_features: Multi-way merge of 3 sorted input files
OCCURS table for status lookup (tablaEstado occurs 30 times)
Paginated report with page counter and line counter
Spanish-language data names and business domain
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Tab-indented source with mixed indentation styles. Hardcoded Windows paths (C:\) and Spanish identifiers (CUIT, CONSORCIOS, BAJAS, NOVEDADES) strongly suggest an Argentine university student exercise. The program-id 'Program1' is a generic placeholder typical of student work. Minor logic issues present (e.g., missing period after first IF in determinarMenor, potential scope issues).
